comparison.objective: Move four tubes into a bath while keeping their caps above a line; unlike damper tuning.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated tube grasping, transport, orientation, and release versus hex-key alignment, bimanual counterholding, fine rotation, and torque-limited locking.
comparison.success_condition: All four tubes in the bath with caps above the line versus two safe repeatable stopping cycles with retained adjustment. Bath/line tolerances are unspecified; specs are empty.
comparison.reason: This tests constrained placement and orientation, not adjustment and validation of a dynamic mechanism.
